evidence.detail: deck-by-card search exists only at /admin/archetypes/ behind @auth.demimod_required; calls ds.load_decks_by_cards()
load_decks_by_cards(names, not_names) implements card-name filtering but no win-rate parameter
no public-facing deck-search route or win-rate filter found anywhere in the codebase

triage.notes: Requires decisions on: whether to expose deck search publicly or only to logged-in users, what the UI looks like (search bar vs. faceted filters), and whether win-rate filter is a WHERE clause or post-filter; scope is larger than easy-fix even ignoring the product questions.
